degree-of-freedom expression

  • CURIE: gmeow:dofExpression
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/dofExpression
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/music

The Expression whose parameter determination this DegreeOfFreedom declares. Exactly one of dofWork or dofExpression is required per relator; SHACL enforces the XOR.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:DegreeOfFreedom -> gmeow:Expression; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:dofExpression from gmeow:DegreeOfFreedom to gmeow:Expression when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
